{"candidate": "On 30 August 2023 the Council voted on two separate drafts. S/2023/638 failed 13–1–1 because Russia, a permanent member, voted against. S/2023/639 failed 1–1–13. France and the UAE sought to renew sanctions and continue the Panel of Experts. France supported that draft to sustain the peace agreement through the drawdown and abstained on Russia's alternative. Russia opposed the first draft, supported its own and said the earlier approach had missed Mali's concerns. The Russian draft proposed a final extension and immediate dissolution of the Panel. Both texts would have extended sanctions temporarily, with disagreement over the Panel and whether renewal would be final. Neither draft was adopted or authorized new measures.", "field": "What reason does the record give for the failure of S/2023/639?", "choices": {"A": "Insufficient votes in favour.", "B": "A permanent-member veto.", "C": "No reason stated."}}
